Punycode Converter

Real IDN punycode encode/decode (RFC 3492, implemented locally) — verified against known test vectors.

Self-test: running…

📖 How to use

  1. Type a domain or label (e.g. münchen.de).
  2. Click Encode for punycode, Decode for Unicode.
  3. Check the built-in self-test result.
  4. Copy or download the conversion.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is punycode?

The RFC 3492 encoding that represents Unicode domain labels in ASCII, e.g. münchen → xn--mnchen-3ya.

How do I know it is correct?

The tool self-tests on load against the known vector "münchen" ↔ "xn--mnchen-3ya" and shows PASS/FAIL.

Does it handle full domains?

Yes — each dot-separated label is converted independently; ASCII labels pass through.

Is anything sent to a server?

No — the algorithm is implemented in JavaScript and runs entirely in your browser.
